We are hiring a Tax Senior Associate, reporting to the CFO. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.

This is a unique opportunity for an astute and forward-thinking tax professional to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will design and own the tax processes that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business—tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.

In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and strategic thinking over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK
Manage and coordinate the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings
Work with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation
Act as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.
Identify opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation
Manage and run tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements
Work closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment
Monitor changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.

d: This role runs warehousing and logistics for Calo across multiple countries. That includes our own warehouses, our 3PL partners and cross-border shipments. The biggest goal is to bring down our total storage cost per pallet while keeping the kitchens supplied and improve overall accuracy and traceability. We are looking for someone who has led warehouse operations before, can come in and make real improvements quickly, and knows how to use tech and AI to take our warehouses to the next level. The team is spread across several countries, so most of the management will be done remotely.
q: 7+ years in warehousing and logistics, with at least 4 years leading warehouse operations. Food, cold chain or FMCG experience preferred.
Has managed 3PL warehouses, including contracts, rate negotiations, invoice checks and performance reviews.
Has reduced warehouse or storage cost in a previous role and can show the numbers.
Has improved inventory accuracy using tech such as a WMS or barcode scanning.
Uses AI tools in their daily work and has practical ideas on how to use them in a warehouse.
Has managed teams across more than one site or country, including remotely.
Good knowledge of cold chain, food safety (HACCP or ISO) and FEFO.
Experience with imports, customs clearance and freight (sea, air and land) in the GCC.
Willing to travel within the GCC around 5 times a year.
Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, engineering or a related field. Lean or Six Sigma is a plus.
Storage cost per pallet keeps going down, across our own warehouses and 3PLs.
Clear improvements in the first 90 days, backed by numbers.
Stock in the system matches what is on the shelf, and the business trusts the numbers.
The kitchens don't stop because of a warehouse or logistics issue.
Manual sheets are replaced by proper tools, and the team uses tech and AI every day.
Market teams hit their KPIs without needing to be chased.
Has developed a successor in each market.
r: Reduce storage cost per pallet What defines this role
Own our total storage cost per pallet, for our own warehouses and 3PLs combined. Bring it down and keep it down.
Track it by site every month and understand what is driving it, whether that is rent, labour, 3PL rates, handling or space we pay for and don't use.
Make better use of the space we have. Fix layouts, clear out slow-moving and expired stock, and stop paying for pallet positions we don't need.
Renegotiate 3PL contracts and rates, check every invoice line, and push back on charges we should not be paying.
Use the numbers to decide when a market should use a 3PL and when we should run the warehouse ourselves.

Bring in better ways to track inventory using tech and AI, in our own warehouses and at the 3PLs. This could be barcode scanning at receiving and dispatch, RFID Technology, real-time stock visibility, or AI that flags stock gaps and expiry risks early.
Get system stock to match physical stock in every market. Set up regular cycle counts, find the root cause of every big variance and fix it.
Work with our AI and automation team to replace manual sheets with proper tools.
Build the plan for warehouse automation as volumes grow.
Explore and find the biggest problems in our warehouses and start fixing them straight away. Show the results in numbers.

Run day-to-day warehouse operations through team members in the assigned markets, including receiving, storage, expiry management and supplying the kitchens, with food safety and cold chain standards met at every site.

Manage cross-border logistics, including sea and air shipments from international suppliers, truck movements between GCC markets, and customs clearance. Keep freight cost and lead times under control.
Put the same SOPs and KPIs in place across assigned markets.
Plan storage capacity ahead of growth.
Manage the warehouse and inventory teams in each assigned market and the cross-border logistics team. They report to this role.
Most of the team is in other countries, so this person needs to be good at managing remotely. Weekly KPI reviews, clear targets, and quick follow-up when something slips.
Coach the market leads and develop successors.
Travel within the GCC around 5 times a year to visit the sites, the teams and our 3PL partners.
Work closely with Procurement, Kitchen Operations, Quality and Finance, and keep Supply Chain leadership updated early on performance and risks.
Storage cost per pallet: total across our own warehouses and 3PLs, reduced against target
Inventory accuracy: system stock matches physical stock at every site
Kitchen supply: no production stoppages caused by warehouse or logistics issues
Waste: expiry and damage write-offs against target
These are the core KPIs for the role today. KPIs are reviewed regularly and will be changed, removed or added as Calo grows.
